thread:
Clara (Design): uploaded a small iteration for the vectors table paging + export flow: https://www.figma.com/file/unique-paging. Changes: sticky header, compact row variant, and new export microcopy. quick eye pls. Ben (PM): sticky header looks good. product ask: when users switch density, keep scroll position stable so they don't lose context. also show an inline range like 'Showing 1-50 of 12,345' in the header. Diego (Eng): agree on stable scroll. implementation note: when density toggles we can preserve the first visible row index and scroll to it after reflow. also we need to virtualize rows when total > 1k to avoid perf hits. Ava (A11y): a11y notes: sticky headers should still be reachable by keyboard and read by VoiceOver. add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to the range text to announce changes. when density changes announce 'Compact view on' / 'Compact view off'. Nora (Product): export copy: change "Export" to "Download vectors (CSV)" and helper line: "Only visible columns will be included. Filters and selections apply." add small checkbox: "Include rerank metadata (model, score)". design-bot: contrast check: sticky header bg #F8FAFF with text #4B5563 passes AA. export CTA #0062D0 on #FFFFFF passes large text only. Recommend #0055B8 for small text. Clara (Design): will update CTA color and add the helper line. planning to show '10k+' shorthand for totals over 10000. Ben (PM): for huge exports (>10k) switch to background export and show a toast: 'Your CSV is being prepared. We'll email you when it's ready.' good? Diego (Eng): yes. backend will generate background jobs for >10k and return a job id + download link. client shows estimated file size if possible. Ava (A11y): sample ARIA for the range and density toggle: ```
Showing 1-50 of 12,345
``` Also ensure the sticky header has `role=\"banner\"` and keyboard focusable controls. Clara (Design): re: preview card: shrinking height in compact mode and allowing a small chevron to expand full preview. keyboard flow: tab into row -> press preview -> focus moves to preview heading -> ESC closes. Diego (Eng): will implement focus move and ESC behavior. we'll lazy-load preview content and show skeleton while fetching. arrow keys should navigate between rows when a preview is open. Nora (Product): timeline: need final copy + a11y snippets by Wed so eng can start. please include mock for 10k+ state and background export modal. Clara (Design): will push updates Tue EOD: color tweak, copy changes, 10k+ mock, aria notes. thanks all :thumbsup: Ava (A11y): quick checklist for follow-up: 1) announce density changes 2) aria-live for range updates 3) role=dialog & trap for export modal 4) export modal title gets initial focus 5) ensure background export flow accessible (status + link). I'll re-test after update. Diego (Eng): noted. will prep virtualization + background export hooks. Ben (PM): nice work team. closing once Figma and spec doc updated.
